files.summary: Three-pillar architecture (Knowledge Graph, /vibeplan, Ralph), component map, per-iteration flow with model routing from task tier and QC pinned to MODEL_QC, rate-limit auto-resume in-process (RALPH_EXIT_RATE_LIMIT=75, DECISION:015), tasks/brief archive split, sync-agent mode dispatch, runtime state gitignore policy (DECISION:011), and key boundaries.

Script style, commit prefixes, sentinel protocol, skill format, verify_build() stack-awareness, model routing/tier convention (tier→model mapping, escalation, QC pinning), structured delta obligation, archive file naming, runtime state gitignore policy with scoped safety_commit (DECISION:011), single-instance concurrency guard (pid-liveness check, --force override, EXIT-trap release), untrack-on-adopt for state/ (DECISION:012), rate-limit auto-resume in-process (RALPH_EXIT_RATE_LIMIT=75, DECISION:015), no-background-commands rule for agents, sync hook arg convention, session policy.
Runtime dependencies (bash, python3, claude CLI) and tooling assumptions for vibekit itself.
Append-only architectural decision log with anchors. 005 entries covering distribution, verify_build, manifest.json, checkpoint QC, and active/archive split.
